location_label: THE CACHE — DEAD MINING STATION, FORGOTTEN ROUTE

availability.note: CAPTAINS' BRIEF IN ~40 MIN. NORMAL TRAFFIC QUEUES.

status_lines: STANDING RULE: WHAT TOUCHES SKYLAR IS TOLD TO HIM FIRST, BY HER, IN PRIVATE.
SKYLAR ATTENDS THE CAPTAINS' BRIEF FROM THIS CYCLE FORWARD.
IMPERIAL FILE: HIS FACE AND BLOOD-TEST RESULT ARE ON RECORD. HE CANNOT GO HOME.
HER SHIP: GRAY KOM'RK. THE GAUNTLET WAS DESTROYED AT BEROYA.

open_threads.title: INQUISITOR — PORT TO PORT
open_threads.detail: THE INQUISITOR FROM THE SUNDARI HANDOVER HAS A COMMAND AND A BUDGET. HE IS MOVING PORT TO PORT ASKING ABOUT SKYLAR. HIS LINE POINTS TOWARD THE CACHE.

open_threads.title: SCATTER — DECISION AT THE BRIEF
open_threads.detail: SHE GIVES THE CACHE A MONTH, TWO AT MOST, BEFORE THE STATION MUST SCATTER. THE DECISION GOES TO THE CAPTAINS' BRIEF FIRST.

open_threads.title: RANN — MENDING
open_threads.detail: SHOT COVERING THE RUN TO THE KOM'RK AT SUNDARI. SURVIVED. MENDING.
